appDescription.message: Unofficial, free and open-source Zoho Mail companion: inbox checks, notifications and everyday mail actions.

signInHint.message: Connect your Zoho Mail account in the options page, then reopen this popup.

heroSub.message: Here is what is waiting for you

pollNote.message: Zoho cannot push mail to extensions, so the extension checks at this interval with a very light request. Shorter means new mail shows up sooner.

backupNote.message: Saves only your preferences, never mail or passwords.

connHint.message: If something does not work, reconnect your Zoho account above and check again.

connFolders.message: Archive, Sent and Trash can be read

emptyConfirm.message: Permanently delete all messages in the trash? This cannot be undone.

trashLeft.message: {n} conversations are still in the trash

soundPlayed.message: Sound sent. If you hear nothing, check the system volume.

setupHint.message: The extension talks to Zoho with your own free API client: you create it once in the Zoho API Console (about 2 minutes), then paste its Client ID and Client Secret below.

secretNote.message: Client ID, Client Secret and the access token stay in this browser and are sent only to Zoho.

missingCredentials.message: Client ID and Client Secret are required.

waitingZoho.message: Waiting for the Zoho sign-in window…

guideTitle.message: How to get Client ID and Client Secret

guide1.message: Open the Zoho API Console of your data center: {link} (sign in with your Zoho account). Change the data center below if your mail is not on this one.

guide2.message: Click "Add Client" (or "Get Started" the first time) and choose "Server-based Applications".

guide3.message: Client Name: anything, e.g. Zoho Mail Checker. Homepage URL: {home}

guide4.message: Authorized Redirect URIs: paste exactly {uri} (use the Copy button below: no spaces, no trailing slash).

guide5.message: Press "Create", then open the "Client Secret" tab: copy Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.

guide6.message: Press "Connect to Zoho", sign in on the Zoho page that opens and accept the requested permissions (read and manage your mail).

trouble1.message: "Invalid Redirect Uri": the redirect URI in the API Console must match the one below character by character. Edit the client there and paste it again.

trouble2.message: "invalid_client": Client ID or Secret are wrong, or the client was created in a different data center than the one selected here.

trouble3.message: The badge shows "!": access was revoked or expired. Press "Reconnect".

trouble4.message: Client Secret and tokens stay in this browser only and are sent only to Zoho; "Disconnect" also revokes access on Zoho.
